Use case: stylized-concept. Game asset: an actual artist-drawn animation flipbook on genuine transparency for a premium dark-fantasy Korean 2.5D RPG. Deliver a LANDSCAPE 4-column by 3-row atlas: EXACTLY twelve equally spaced cells, 4 drawings per row, 3 rows; read row-major in time. Invisible equal rectangular cells occupy the whole canvas. One evolving spell in each cell. Lock the SAME 3/4 side-view camera and local origin (bottom middle, 80 percent cell height), scale and palette in every cell. Each drawing stays completely inside the central 78% of its own cell. Transparent gutters, no dividers, no cell numbers, no captions, no floating text, no character, no pedestal, no landscape, no border. Space around the whole effect is truly TRANSPARENT, including negative spaces in the magic. Sparse intentional particles, no full-tile fog. Polished hand-inked high contrast game VFX with fierce taper, bright core and rich material rendering, effective against a midnight battlefield. Show twelve GENUINELY DIFFERENT temporal animation drawings: 1-3 anticipation, 4-6 acceleration, 7-8 decisive peak impact, 9-12 shape-changing aftermath/recovery. Start and end faint but visible. The sequence must read as one continuous action, not twelve collectible icons or twelve different objects.

The empty center lies above the common groundline in every cell. Dark silver metal with thick painterly black edges and a narrow bright raspberry-red edge light; preserve transparency between each link. No magic circle or UI.
